about: Vonda M. Sargent, an attorney with The Law Offices of Vonda M. Sargent in Seattle, Washington, helps clients address Civil Rights situations. She also helps clients with Personal Injury - General: Plaintiff and Employment Litigation: Plaintiff concerns.
She received legal training from Seattle University School of Law. She graduated from law school in 1994. Vonda Sargent became licensed to practice law in 1994.
Vonda Sargent was selected to Super Lawyers. The designation means that she is a top-rated attorney as recognized by peers. She was selected to Super Lawyers for 2012 - 2026.

The Super Lawyers patented selection process is peer influenced and research driven, selecting the top 5% of attorneys to the Super Lawyers lists each year. We know lawyers and make it easy to connect with them.
